name: campaign
description: The discovery campaign ledger: durable admission, settlement and revisions for paid judging.

actions.init: a new CampaignStore on an empty ledger
actions.push: a new CampaignStore for the next immutable revision on the same ledger

mutants.name: double-settle
mutants.description: settle() accepts an already settled reservation and refunds its credit again

mutants.name: credit-per-call
mutants.description: every advance() mints exploration credit, not only a new revision's first

mutants.name: residual-skips-pass
mutants.description: residual reserve() does not wait for the revision's protected attempts to be answered

mutants.name: no-dedupe
mutants.description: reserve() admits the same pair twice on one revision

limits: One judge, two pairs, one family, two revisions, no subscription judge, providers billing within their reservation. Ordering (CampaignStore.order) and concurrency between processes are outside the model.
